name: gettowayz-apps
description: GettoWayz phone apps (Android APK + iOS). Both are built from the same web code as the website in the repo root.

scripts.android: node scripts/sync-web.mjs && npx cap sync android && node scripts/patch-native.mjs android
scripts.ios: node scripts/sync-web.mjs && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/patch-native.mjs ios
scripts.all: node scripts/sync-web.mjs && npx cap sync && node scripts/patch-native.mjs
